mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and levonorgestrel alone provides insufficient contraceptive efficacy; combined hormonal contraception with additional barrier methods is required for isotretinoin safety.
action: Levonorgestrel-only contraception is contraindicated with isotretinoin; patient must use two forms of contraception (combined oral contraceptive plus barrier method or IUD) and enroll in iPLEDGE program before isotretinoin initiation.
